sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Farm Block Puzzle is a block-matching game where you're presented with a grid and a set of falling blocks. Your goal is to create a solid line of blocks without any gaps, using the given falling blocks. The game's core mechanics are simple yet demanding, requiring players to think critically and plan ahead to achieve success.

As new blocks fall into the grid, you'll need to rotate and arrange them to create a solid line. You can move the blocks left or right, rotate them, and drop them down to create a solid line. If you manage to create a solid line, you'll earn points and clear the line. The game becomes increasingly challenging as you progress through the levels, introducing new block types and obstacles that will test your skills and strategy.

The game's core mechanics are easy to learn, but mastering them requires patience, practice, and strategy.
